blocks.text: Duration of Non-Heparin Anticoagulation in HIT:
HIT without thrombosis treatment should be continued for 4 weeks
HIT with thrombosis (HIT-T) treatment should be continued for 3 months
Use the non-heparin anticoagulant until platelet recovery and at least the above durations.
